intro: The Empty Red Waterskin is a leather vessel entrusted to fledgling shaman during their elemental trials. It is used to collect fresh, untainted water from a surprising source in the plagued town of Tarren Mill.

p: Given by the hermit Brine in the Barrens, this plain red skin serves a vital spiritual purpose in the Call of Water trials. Initiates are tasked with carrying it far across the sea to the Hillsbrad Foothills, seeking out the town of Tarren Mill. Though the town is occupied by the Forsaken and steeped in undeath, a lone well in its center continues to draw sweet, pristine spring water. Filling the red waterskin captures a vital sample of life persevering amidst blight, which Brine blends into a vial of purest water for the initiate's trial.
